breakdown.description: The name-consistency check mixes the `Mg_Ga` charge-state group with a Ga-vacancy reference entry.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes loading a Ga-vacancy reference entry from `Ga_vacancy/vasprun.xml.gz` and `Ga_vacancy/LOCPOT.gz` and mixing it into the name-consistency check. The ground truth only checks consistency across the Mg_Ga charge-state group (charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1]) without any Ga-vacancy reference entry. The agent repeated the original error.
